title: Move hardcoded payment credentials to .env in Python aiogram bot
description: ## Task: Move hardcoded phone/card to .env in payment handler ### Context FishBot — Telegram bot. Python 3.12, aiogram 3.x. File: `bot/config.py`, `bot/handlers/payment.py` ### Problem Manual payment instructions contain hardcoded phone/card number in source code: ```python # bot/handlers/payment.py MANUAL_INSTRUCTIONS = ( "Переведи на карту: 4276 1234 5678 9012\n" # HARDCODED "или по номеру: +7 (999) 123-45-67\n" # HARDCODED "Комментарий: FishBot Pro {user_id}" ) ``` ### Fix 1. Add to `bot/config.py`: ```python MANUAL_PAYMENT_PHONE = os.getenv("MANUAL_PAYMENT_PHONE", "") MANUAL_PAYMENT_CARD = os.getenv("MANUAL_PAYMENT_CARD", "") ``` 2. Update payment.py to use config values: ```python from bot.config import MANUAL_PAYMENT_PHONE, MANUAL_PAYMENT_CARD async def show_manual_payment(cb, user): if not MANUAL_PAYMENT_PHONE and not MANUAL_PAYMENT_CARD: await cb.answer("Ручная оплата временно недоступна", show_alert=True) return text = "Переведи на:" if MANUAL_PAYMENT_CARD: text += f"\nКарта: {MANUAL_PAYMENT_CARD}" if MANUAL_PAYMENT_PHONE: text += f"\nТелефон: {MANUAL_PAYMENT_PHONE}" text += f"\nКомментарий: FishBot Pro {html.escape(str(user.tg_id))}" await cb.message.edit_text(text, parse_mode="HTML", reply_markup=kb_back()) ``` 3. Add to `.env.example`: ``` MANUAL_PAYMENT_PHONE=+7XXXXXXXXXX MANUAL_PAYMENT_CARD=XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX ``` ### Deliverable Updated `config.py` (2 new vars) + updated `show_manual_payment` handler + `.env.example` additions. Valid Python 3.12.
